# Descriptions
@@ 1
Allows caster to research special imbedding spells to be used in creating
items.
@@ 3
Allows caster to imbed a 1st level spell from a realm other than that of the
caster in an item or potion.
@@ 5
Allows caster to charge a wand from a realm other than that of the caster .
@@ 6
As Imbed 1, except 1st or 2nd level spells can be imbedded.
@@ 7
Allows caster to imbed a 1st level spell (using an Imbed spell) that can be
cast once per day.
@@ 9
As Imbed 1, except 1st through 3rd level spells can be imbedded.
@@ 10
As Charge Wand, except rods from a realm other than that of the castercan be
charged.
@@ 11
As Daily I, except 1st through 3rd level spells can be imbedded; a 1st level
spell could be cast 3 times per day; a 2nd or 3rd, once per day.
@@ 12
As Imbed 1, except 1st through 4th level spells can be imbedded.
@@ 14
As Imbed 1, except 1st through 5th level spells can be imbedded.
@@ 15
As Daily I, except 1st through 5th level spells can be imbedded; a 1st level
spell could be cast 5 times per day; a 2nd twice a day; a 3rd, 4th, or 5th,
once per day.
@@ 20
As Charge Wand, except staves from a realm other than that of the caster can
be charged.
@@ 25
As Imbed 1, except 1st through 10th level spells can be imbedded.
@@ 30
As Daily I, except 1st through 10th level spells can be imbedded; a 1st level
spell could be cast 10 times per day; a 2nd 5x/day; a 3rd 3x/day; a 4th, or
5th 2x/day; a 6th, 7th, 8th, 9th, or 10th, once a day.
@@ 50
Allows a spell of 1st to 10th (from a realm other than that of the caster)
level to be imbedded (using an imbed spell) so that it functions constantly.
